title: Anthropic launches SMB AI workflows #anthropic #aiworkflows #smallbusiness
description:
Anthropic launched Claude for Small Businesses with 15 pre-built AI workflows for tasks like invoice chasing, payroll planning, and month-end close. The bigger opportunity is not just using the tools, but implementing them for local businesses that are unlikely to set them up on their own.

The model turns AI adoption into a service business: install the workflows, manage them, and charge both setup and monthly maintenance fees. For freelancers, consultants, and operators, that creates a practical path to recurring income tied to real business outcomes.

The invoice chaser stands out as the clearest entry point because it automates a task small business owners already avoid and proves value as soon as it helps recover overdue payments. Anthropic’s free two-hour training and certification lowers the barrier to entry and signals growing demand for AI workflow implementers in the small business market.
